name: Can accessibility modifications like walk-in showers and grab bars be integrated into a remodel?

mainEntity.name: Can accessibility modifications like walk-in showers and grab bars be integrated into a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full remodel is the ideal time to add zero-threshold showers, wider doorways, grab-bar backing, and comfort-height vanities. Installing solid wood blocking inside the wall framing during the rough-in stage ensures future grab bars or shower benches are anchored securely to studs rather than relying on drywall anchors. Choosing curbless walk-in showers with linear drains provides barrier-free entry while delivering a clean, modern aesthetic. These adjustments ensure your bathroom remains comfortable, secure, and usable as mobility needs change over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Framing in solid wall backing and installing curbless showers during a remodel allows seamless, sturdy accessibility without sacrificing modern design.
